prompt: Map a month number to its season with a switch: December-February is winter, March-May spring, June-August summer, September-November fall, anything outside 1-12 is invalid.
explanation: A switch expression (Java 14+) returns a value directly, so the whole method body can be one return switch (...) { ... }. Arrow labels like case 12, 1, 2 -> group several constants on one line with no fall-through and no break statements. The default branch handles every month outside 1-12.
hints: A switch expression can be returned directly: return switch (month) { ... };
Arrow cases take several labels at once: case 12, 1, 2 -> "winter";
Use default -> "invalid"; to cover everything outside 1..12.
